name: Minimal Gallery
summary: Curated gallery of website designs, browsable by industry tag and platform (Framer, Webflow, WordPress …), plus templates and tools.
description: Hand-picked website design inspiration running since 2013. Browse websites by industry tag (AI, portfolio, startup, agency, e-commerce, SaaS, type foundry …) and by platform (Framer, Webflow, WordPress, Astro, Tailwind …); each entry shows a screenshot with viewport info and submitter, links to the live site and lists similar websites. There is also a curated templates section and a directory of tools for creatives, plus a weekly email digest.
